providers.reasoning: OpenAI GPT via OPENAI_API_KEY (exclusive in production)
providers.vision_review: Two-tier via ONE OpenRouter key: Qwen VL (qwen/qwen-2.5-vl-72b-instruct) primary ~80%, escalate difficult/low-confidence cases to Gemini 2.5 Flash (google/gemini-2.5-flash) ~20% — both through OPENROUTER_API_KEY. OpenAI permitted as vision fallback. Imperfect critiques are salvaged into valid change orders instead of hard-failing.
providers.image_generation: BFL FLUX Kontext via BFL_API_KEY (exclusive in production)
providers.reference_motion: Reference video motion dynamics (energy/tempo/cut-rate) measured via frame differencing and fed to the animation director so motion matches the reference's rhythm; guarded (no-op if measurement fails).
providers.animation: Authored animation DSL per shot (Director-authored: object state change is primary; camera/particles/captions are opt-in supporting elements, off by default). Renderer is a pure executor. Primary quality gate is causal clarity, not motion energy.
providers.object_separation: Grounded: ObjectGrounder (Qwen VL authors bbox/points/pivot/depth/states; deterministic fallback) -> SAM2 prompted by that grounding (not image centre), heuristic fallback -> mask QC gate (empty/near-full/bbox-overlap/duplicate) with retry. Per-object alpha masks; visible pixels always from the beauty frame.
providers.art_direction: Flat vector science-explainer (Kurzgesagt-style): bold separable shapes, clean outlines, flat fills, negative space for labels. Replaces the painterly editorial-ink canon.
providers.compositing: Per-object clean-plate compositing: moving objects removed from an inpainted background plate (OpenCV Telea or PIL bleed fallback); depth z-index preserved from grounded depth (not flattened); object-local rotate/scale about the object pivot.
providers.renderers: PIL (deterministic/offline) and Remotion (production) consume the SAME authored DSL (events/camera/effects/captions + per-layer pivot/bbox/z). The Remotion template iterates all events per layer (not one), applies easing, transforms about the object pivot, and executes camera/effect/caption directives.
providers.post_render_qc: Rendered causal clarity is verified from real first/last frames + the object mask: an action shot must show the object region actually change; a declared hold must not. render_verified is set from frame evidence (not JSON). Optional Qwen VL before/after gate is GPU/API-gated. Wired as a guarded pipeline pass writing 20_render_qc/*.json.
